authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong technical execution in rendering plastic toys with consistent lighting, shadows, and material properties. However, two minor structural artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) slight fusion of the central giraffe's front legs near the hooves, lacking clean separation; (2) a faint vertical seam/texture misalignment on the right giraffe's neck/chest junction. These are subtle manufacturing-style flaws that could be intentional for realism but also resemble common AI generation artifacts. The fine-grained classifier's misidentification further suggests non-standard geometry. Overall, it is a high-quality generation with minor imperfections that prevent a perfect score.
